## Service and outreach

- Volunteer Technician, [NWA Black Heritage East Mountain Cemetery Project](https://nwablackheritage.org/cemeteries). Proximal sensing (electrical resistivity, ground penetrating radar) to locate unmarked graves, in partnership with the Arkansas Archeological Survey.
- Board Member, [Tri Cycle Farms](https://www.tricyclefarms.org/). Food recovery and redistribution programs.
- YouthMappers at UArk. Volunteer mapping for disaster relief through [Humanitarian OpenStreetMap](https://www.hotosm.org/).

## Skills

**Languages and platforms.** Python, R, Google Earth Engine, NetLogo, PCI Geomatica, mobile GIS and GPS field collection

**Remote sensing.** UAV/UAS operation and program development, hyperspectral and multispectral imaging, satellite time series, synthetic aperture radar processing, multi-sensor data fusion, phenology-based classification

**Modeling and analysis.** Interpretable machine learning (SHAP), random forest and gradient boosting, spatial cross-validation, boundary line analysis, species distribution modeling (MaxEnt), GIS-based multicriteria evaluation, agent-based modeling

**Proximal sensing.** Ground penetrating radar, apparent electrical conductivity, electrical resistivity
